experiment.title: SCE 1.3: Preventive Probe - IAM Deny ec2:DescribeInstances
experiment.description: Validates that explicit IAM deny policy on ec2:DescribeInstances prevents EC2 instance enumeration. Attack Step 1.2 (T1526) is simulated; preventive control blocks attacker access at authorization layer.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Preventive Control: IAM Deny on ec2:DescribeInstances

method.name: Establish Steady State
method.description: Deploy CloudFormation stack with dev/build role, explicit deny policy, and test EC2 instance

method.name: Execute Attack Step 1.2: Enumerate EC2 Instances
method.description: Simulate attacker with dev/build role attempting ec2:DescribeInstances API call. Expected result: access denied due to explicit deny policy.

rollbacks.name: Teardown Experiment Resources
rollbacks.description: Delete CloudFormation stack and all provisioned resources
